title: fix(cog): report overwrites as overwritten, not imported
body:
The cosmetic finding from the #211 browser passes.

## What was wrong

`bulkImportCOGRecords` had no counter for overwrites, so it folded them into `imported`. An overwrite run reported **"Imported 3"** while the on-contract line beneath said **"0 of 3 imported"** — the same Summary contradicting itself.

## What changed

A separate `overwritten` count, end to end:

- the overwrite branch increments `overwritten`; `imported` is inserts only
- **the recompute gate** was `if (imported > 0)` — overwrites only passed it by inflating `imported`. It's now `imported + overwritten > 0`, so a pure-overwrite run (rows whose cost and vendor just changed) still recomputes match statuses. This is the one behavioural edge a blind rename would have broken.
- audit metadata and both result types (the action's return, the API route's `COGImportResult`) carry the field; the API's zero-result early returns set it to `0`
- the Summary shows four tiles — **Imported · Overwritten · Skipped · Errors** — plus "N overwritten · N skipped · N errors" and "matched of N processed" with N = imported + overwritten

The test that pinned the old semantics (`imported 2 // 1 overwrite + 1 new`) now asserts `imported 1 / overwritten 1`.

## Deliberately not changed

The Summary's matched/unmatched/on-contract stats window on `createdAt` within the last 60 s to approximate "this import" (see the comment above `IMPORT_STATS_WINDOW_MS`), so rows that were *overwritten* rather than created never count there — "Matched 0" on an overwrite run. Documented approximation, separate from this fix.

## Verified, on a production build

- Overwrite pass driven in the browser against three existing rows → **Imported 0 / Overwritten 3 / Skipped 0 / Errors 0**, "3 overwritten · 0 skipped · 0 errors", "0 of 3 processed"; the three rows stayed three, all updated, match statuses recomputed
- `/api/import-cog` now returns `"overwritten":0` on its skip path
- `tsc` 0 · `lint:ci` passes · vitest **4704** · e2e **143** · visual **95** · prod log 0 errors
